title: Phase 4b: the articulator
intro: DelayLamaVoice now shapes every note itself (protocol 1, 1 ms control ticks) from the profiles in profiles/imitation.json. The onset glitches came from the vowel moving at full level near a note's start: Delay Lama's formants are narrow, so a moving vowel is heard as a falling ping (low notes) or a whistle where it crosses a harmonic (high notes). onset.mask keeps the level low until the vowel has arrived. Whether that sounds right is your call.
